questions.text: Ramani sells her car to Sarla at a loss of 15%. If Sarla pays ₹1,91,250 for it, then what is the cost price of the car for Ramani? Ans A). B). C). D). Correct Answer: A
. 880 B). 900 C). 840 D). 860 Correct Answer: D
Three numbers are in the ratio 3 : 4 : 5 and their HCF is 60. The numbers are: Ans A). 20, 15, 12 B). 180, 240, 300 C). 45, 60,75 D). 90, 120, 150 Correct Answer: B
In a park there are rabbits and pigeons in the ratio 4 : 9. If legs are counted, the total number of legs is 340. Find the number of rabbits. Ans A). 40 B). 70 C). 30 D). 20 Correct Answer: A
. B). C). D). Correct Answer: D
Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹3000 as a sum borrowed at 9% per year rate of interest for 3 years. Ans A). 770 B). 850 C). 750 D). 810 Correct Answer: D
The average weight of a family of five members (in kg) whose weights are 40 kg, 49 kg, 56 kg, 68 kg and 35 kg is: Ans A). 48.6 B). 49.6 C). 50.6 D). 51.6 Correct Answer: B

Two candidates contested in an election. One of them secured 62.5% of the total votes and won by 996 votes. What is the total number of votes cast?(all votes are valid) Ans A). 1594 B). 2656 C). 3984 D). 2988 Correct Answer: C
The average of the numbers 253, 245, 325, 120 and 115+2K is 212. Find the average of the numbers 353, 354, 225, 220 and 110+3K. Ans A). 252 B). 250 C). 253 D). 251 Correct Answer: C
The lengths of the two diagonals of a rhombus are 20 cm and 23 cm. What is the area (in cm2) of the rhombus? Ans A). 460 B). 345 C). 230 D). 115 Correct Answer: C

By selling an article for ₹19.5, a dealer makes a profit of 10%. By how much should he increase his selling price (in ₹, rounded off to two decimal place) so as to make a profit of 50%? Ans A). 10.09 B). 7.09 C). 8.09 D). 9.09 Correct Answer: B

The average score obtained by 64 boys and a certain number of girls in a test is 59.15, while the average score obtained by the boys is 55.25. If the average score of the girls is 68.75, then how many girls appeared for the test? Ans A). 27 B). 28 C). 25 D). 26 Correct Answer: D

Sharad invested two equal amounts for 6 years and 3 years at the rate of 7% and 9% per annum, respectively. The sum of their simple interest is ₹1,587. The invested amount (in ₹) by Sharad is: Ans A). 4,650 B). 4,600 C). 4,374 D). 4,550 Correct Answer: B
Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2000 as a sum borrowed at 9% per year rate of interest for 2 years. Ans A). 400 B). 360 C). 320 D). 300 Correct Answer: B

The speed of a boat in still water is 13 km/h and the speed of the stream is 4 km/h. How much more time will it take in going upstream than ingoing downstream a distance of 68 km? (Correct to the nearest minute) Ans A). 3 h 30 min B). 3 h 50 min C). 3 h 33 min D). 2 h 55 min Correct Answer: C

The marked price of a chair is ₹1,800 and a discount of 18% is offered on the marked price. What additional discount must be offered to the customer now to bring the net price to ₹1,220? (Correct to two places of decimals.) Ans A). 13.47% B). 31.47% C). 17.34% D). 14.37% Correct Answer: C

The average weight of a class of 115 students is 52.4 kg. If the average weight of the 63 boys is 60 kg, then find the average weight (in kg) of the girls in the class. (Rounded off to one decimal place) Ans A). 41.8 B). 45.5 C). 47.6 D). 43.2 Correct Answer: D
. 250 B). 175 C). 200 D). 225 Correct Answer: C

In a circular race of 1500 m, P and Q start from the same point and at the same time, at speeds of 20 km/h and 35 km/h, respectively. After what time will they meet for the first time on the track if they are running in the same direction? Ans A). 340 sec B). 640 sec C). 840 sec D). 360 sec Correct Answer: D
